statement: ∀ (x : ℝ), x * Real.exp (-x) ≤ Real.exp (-1) ∧ 1 * Real.exp (-1) = Real.exp (-1)
script:
# name: set-x-exp-le-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Compact.x_exp_le
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1'], True, 'have key : ∀ (x : ℝ), x * Real.exp (-x) ≤ Real.exp (-1) ∧ 1 * Real.exp (-1) = Real.exp (-1) := by
  intro x
  refine ⟨?_, one_mul _⟩
  have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (x - 1)
  have hx : Real.exp (-x) = Real.exp (-1) * Real.exp (-(x - 1)) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
  rw [hx]
  have hpos := Real.exp_pos (-(x - 1))
  have : x * Real.exp (-(x - 1)) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    rw [mul_inv_le_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)]
    linarith
  nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-1)]
exact @key (1)'),
